ईडरवारु: īḍara-vāru, īḍige-vāḍu (CITD), Telugu; a toddy-man or arrack-drawer; from īḍa, ‘a date tree’.
ई: īl13a-kkāśu, also called īl13a-kkaruṅ-kāśu and karuṅ-kāśu (SITI); the Ceylonese coin.
ईश: Īśa (EI 23), the god Śiva; the king. (IE 7-1-2), ‘eleven’.
ईश्वरालय: īśvar-ālaya (SII 11-1), a temple; a Śiva temple.
ईरङ्कोल्लि: īraṅkolli, īraṅkoḻḻi (SITI), Tamil; ‘a washerman’; tax payable by washermen.
